name: Morris Island Lighthouse
elevationDatum: Local y=0 is an estimated calm water surface at the cofferdam; no absolute sea-level, DEM, tide or Mercator scale. Only above-water foundation is authored.
note: Current 1876 tower, weathered brown/white bands and open lantern/gallery. Overall 49.07 m chosen as an estimate from the published 161 ft figure; NRHP summary instead gives 150 ft and an inconsistent base diameter. Cofferdam 72 ft / 21.95 m sourced from the foundation contractor. Shaft base 10 m and top 5.08 m, band heights, lantern and exposed foundation are photographic estimates. OSM tower way 1528926180 is narrower than the photographed exterior; footprint retained without pretending it is a survey. No surrounding sea mesh or submerged piles.
